record.context_brief: Exponential connection as Levi-Civita connection on multivariate normals
record.original_question: Let N be the statistical Lie group of multivariate normal distributions. Do there exist left invariant semi-Riemannian metrics on N whose Levi-Civita connection coincides with the exponential connection?

evidence.quote: Let N the statistical Lie group of multivariate normal distributions [2]. Are there any left invariant semi-Riemannian metrics on N whose Levi-Civita connection is the exponential connection.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $N$ denote the family of nondegenerate multivariate normal distributions on $\mathbb{R}^n$, parametrized by pairs $(\mu,\Sigma)$ with $\mu\in\mathbb{R}^n$ and $\Sigma$ a symmetric positive-definite $n\times n$ matrix. Endow $N$ with the Lie group structure obtained by identifying $(\mu,\Sigma)$ with the affine transformation $x\mapsto \Sigma^{1/2}x+\mu$, so that the group operation is $(\mu_1,\Sigma_1)\cdot(\mu_2,\Sigma_2)=(\mu_1+\Sigma_1^{1/2}\mu_2,\,\Sigma_1^{1/2}\Sigma_2\Sigma_1^{1/2})$, making $N$ a Lie group of dimension $n+n(n+1)/2$.

On the statistical manifold $N$, define the exponential connection $\nabla^{(e)}$ as the affine connection whose Christoffel symbols vanish in the natural (canonical) parameters $\theta$ of the exponential family representation of the multivariate normal; equivalently, $\nabla^{(e)}$ is the $\alpha=1$ member of Amari's family of $\alpha$-connections, characterized by the fact that the natural parameters of the exponential family form an affine coordinate system.

A semi-Riemannian metric $g$ on $N$ is called left-invariant if for every $h\in N$ the left translation $L_h:N\to N$ is an isometry of $g$. Each semi-Riemannian metric $g$ determines a unique torsion-free metric-compatible affine connection, its Levi-Civita connection $\nabla^g$.

Question: Does there exist a left-invariant semi-Riemannian metric $g$ on $N$ whose Levi-Civita connection $\nabla^g$ equals the exponential connection $\nabla^{(e)}$?
artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution of this specific question was located. The general problem of characterizing which left-invariant connections on a Lie group are Levi-Civita connections of some left-invariant (semi-)Riemannian metric has been studied (e.g., by Pripoae and collaborators), but the specific case of the exponential connection on the multivariate normal Lie group does not appear to have a documented answer in the literature found.

status_evidence.title: Connections compatible with tensors. A characterization of left-invariant Levi-Civita connections in Lie groups
status_evidence.snippet: Characterizes which left-invariant connections on a Lie group arise as the Levi-Civita connection of a left-invariant semi-Riemannian metric.
status_evidence.claim: General framework exists for the question, but the specific case of the exponential connection on multivariate normals is not resolved in this source.
